en.name: Merchant
en.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose to learn the characters of players that have nominated you.

revisions.v1: Once per game, at night*, choose to learn the characters of players that have nominated you.

en.flavor: "Greed is but a word jealous men inflict upon the ambitious." - Marcus Licinius Crassus 115 B.C. - 53 B.C.
en.otherNightReminder: If the Merchant has not yet used their ability: the Merchant either shows a shake 'no' head signal, or a nod 'yes' head signal. If the Merchant chose 'yes', show the character tokens of players with a NOMINATED token (in any order). Place the NO ABILITY token.

zh.name: 商人
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时*，你可以选择得知提名过你的玩家的角色。

revisions.v1: 每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时*，你可以选择得知提名过你的玩家的角色。

zh.flavor: ‘贪婪不过是一个善妒的人们强加在有抱负者身上的词语。’-马库斯·李锡尼·克拉苏 前115-前53
zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒商人，如果商人选择使用能力，向他展示提名过他的玩家的角色标记。
